company.name: June
company.shortDescription: June is a smart oven for your home that makes cooking perfectly easy.
company.description: June is a smart oven for your home that makes cooking perfectly easy. June’s mission is to use the power of technology to make cooking perfectly easy for everyone. we make kitchens feel like magic. We’re here to help the world look forward to cooking dinner again (and breakfast, lunch, snacks, and late-night leftovers too) because we love food. We live for it. So, we wake up every day on a mission to make life taste better. Our team of designers, hardware, and software engineers is committed to transforming the kitchen experience.

productsAndServices.description: A 12-in-1 countertop smart oven that combines multiple cooking functions including convection oven, air fryer, grill, roaster, slow cooker, dehydrator, toaster, broiler, warming drawer, pizza oven, and proofer.
productsAndServices.name: June Oven

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for iOS and Android that connects to the June Oven, providing remote control, cooking progress tracking, live camera feed, temperature graphs, time-lapse videos, and access to guided smart recipes.
productsAndServices.name: June App

productsAndServices.description: An internal system using an HD camera and on-device network to recognize food items placed inside the June Oven and automatically configure optimal cooking programs.
productsAndServices.name: Food ID Technology

productsAndServices.description: A cooking mode in the June Oven that uses individual control of six heating elements to simulate rotisserie-style cooking without physical rotation mechanisms.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual Rotisserie

productsAndServices.description: A notification system that alerts users when cooking is nearly complete and when food is perfectly cooked, based on internal food temperature rather than timers.
productsAndServices.name: Auto Alerts

productsAndServices.description: A built-in wide-angle high-definition camera inside the June Oven that captures live footage and time-lapse videos of cooking sessions, and supports Food ID recognition.
productsAndServices.name: HD Camera
